TIL that Whoopi Goldberg's real name is Caryn Johnson, and she adopted the last name "Goldberg" at her mother's suggestion because a Jewish-sounding name gave her a better chance of making it in Hollywood.

TIL chewing gum can release tiny plastic particles directly into your saliva. Researchers discovered that as gum is chewed, microscopic particles gradually break away from its structure and mix with your saliva.

TIL After losses or ties, Ohio State coach Woody Hayes conducted locker room interviews while completely naked. A journalist from his tenure noted, "He was an ugly guy so it would clear the locker room out pretty fast."

TIL about the Texas A&M University bonfire collapse which killed 12 people and injured 27 others in 1999. The annual tradition started in 1909, but the official school-sanctioned event was canceled after the tragedy.
TIL Pelé once played as a goalkeeper in four matches for Santos, without conceding a single goal.
TIL that Nagasaki holds the oldest Chinese community in Japan. Most were from fujian province of China and were Ming dynasty loyalist who had fled to Japan.

TIL the Tuatara is a reptile native to New Zealand that evolved to have 3 eyes and can live in temperatures as low as 41°F (5°C). Despite its close resemblance to lizards, they in fact are not lizards. Instead being the only living member of the Rhynchocephalia lineage
TIL Alsace and Lorraine don't exist as administrative regions anymore. They got merged with Champagne-Ardenne in 2016.

TIL Extremal Black Holes have the absolute minimum mass allowed for their charge or spin. This drops their temperature to absolute zero, meaning they emit zero Hawking radiation and could theoretically last forever—making them immortal objects that bypass standard black hole death.
TIL that there is a fruit in Indonesia that is poisonous. In order for it to be edible, the fruits have to be boiled and fermented in ash for about 40 days, in which the hydrogen cyanide is removed.
